description.value:
Focus: Masterless survival and adaptable field training.

Ronin are masterless shinobi, survivors, mercenaries, and wanderers whose training is assembled from what kept them alive on the road.

Village: Generic

Clan: None

Bonus Feat: Skilled

Starting Techniques:

  • Taijutsu: Keikai-uchi
  • Doku Hakken no Jutsu
  • Bunshin no Jutsu
